item_short_desc: The Datrex 2400 Calorie Emergency Food Ration is a must-have for any emergency preparedness kit. Each pack contains 12 high-energy coconut-flavored bars, providing a total of 2400 calories to sustain you during critical times. These bars are ready to eat and made from all-natural ingredients, including wheat flour, cane sugar, water, and coconut, ensuring you get essential nutrients and energy when you need it most. With a 5-year shelf life from the manufacturing date, you can trust that they will be ready whenever you need them.
